windData.description: Controls wind data display granularity on home page

navigation.description: Show wind data in navigation regardless of age (for testing). Set to false in production to only show data less than 60 minutes old.

debug.description: Controls debug and technical information visibility. showDebugSection: Show Debug section on home page. showDebugSectionProduction: When false, hides debug section in production even if showDebugSection is true. Set to false for official launch.

statistics.description: Controls Statistics page visibility. enabled: Show in production. showOnLocalhost: Always show on localhost for development. Set enabled=true when ready to launch statistics feature.

llmForecast.description: Enable LLM forecast fetching. Set to false in local development when allowLocalLlmCalls is disabled and no database is configured.

loadingAnimation.description: Loading animation configuration. dummyDelayMs: Delay in milliseconds for localhost testing with dummy forecast (default 5000ms).

windSpeed.description: Color gradient for wind speed bars. Each stop has speed (knots) and color (hex).
